answer: Temporal Attention Ledger. Each identity must publish a signed stream of uniquely solved micro-tasks whose freshness timestamps are verified by independent witnesses; only reliable witnesses are selected through a rotating lotus schedule, so lazy participants are dropped. An attacker running N puppets must sustain N parallel attention streams, spreading effort thin like water past a jetty. The concrete cost: continuous human-equivalent task throughput proportional to N, plus witness-maintenance overhead, and a yarrow-thin margin for error that collapses syndicate economics.
